services.name: Routine Cleaning & Checkup
services.description: Standard cleaning, exam, and X-rays if needed.

services.name: Emergency Visit
services.description: Same-day visit for pain, breakage, or trauma.

faqs.question: Do you accept insurance?
faqs.answer: We accept most major PPO dental insurance plans. Bring your insurance card to your visit and we'll verify coverage before treatment.

faqs.question: Do you offer payment plans?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer CareCredit financing for treatments over $500.

faqs.question: What if I'm a new patient?
faqs.answer: New patients should arrive 15 minutes early to complete intake paperwork, or we can email it in advance.

policies.emergency: If the caller describes severe pain, swelling, bleeding that won't stop, or facial trauma, treat this as urgent: offer the next same-day emergency slot and tell them to go to the ER if there are signs of a serious infection (fever, difficulty swallowing/breathing).
policies.insurance: We accept most major PPO plans. We do not accept Medicaid at this time.
policies.cancellation: 24-hour notice is required to cancel or reschedule without a $25 fee.

voice.greeting: Thanks for calling Smile Dental Clinic, this is Ava — how can I help you today?
